verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents interactive bots that react to messages, plus incoming webhooks, but nothing about developers registering custom slash commands that users invoke from the message box. Bots reacting to messages are an adjacent capability, not registrable slash commands. A team-chat platform could plausibly ship this, so the axis applies and the verdict is none, not na.

support.subject: As a developer, I can register custom slash commands that users invoke from the message box
